QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A12(5) assigns an independent audit of the Registry's administration of phased registration and reporting of findings to the Commission.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Audits the Registry's operational and technical administration of phased registration and reports findings to the Commission.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A14 assigns examination of documentary evidence of prior rights and notification of the result to the Registry; A13 governs selection.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Verify whether domain-name applicants hold the claimed prior rights and notify the Registry of positive or negative findings.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A22(5)-(7) and A23(1): providers receive and examine complaints, forward them, inform the Registry; selected by the Registry.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Receive, examine and forward complaints on domain names, inform the Registry, and administer the ADR procedure.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A10(2) requires the technical construction file to include a technical report or certificate obtained from a competent body (reliance on a named third-party assurance provider).
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Provide technical reports or certificates for manufacturers' technical construction files where standards were not (fully) applied.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A10(4)-(6), Annex II: bodies issue EC type-examination certificates; assessed against Annex II and notified by Member States.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Issue EC type-examination certificates for specified apparatus.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: Applying REV ¶28 literally: Annex II point 5 requires designated bodies to possess civil liability insurance, which necessarily relies on an insurance provider although none is named. No action or function is assigned to the insurer in the text (see child layer).
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Provide the civil liability cover that notified bodies must possess, unless liability is covered by the State.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A10(1),(4); Annex III 3.1-4.4; Annex V(6): designated bodies assess quality systems, carry out surveillance and periodic audits; apply designation criteria to laboratories.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Assess and approve manufacturers' quality systems, evaluate modifications, carry out surveillance, periodic audits and unannounced visits; apply designation criteria to test laboratories.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A10(2): laboratories designated by Member States for carrying out tests pertaining to the conformity procedures; designation subject to criteria applied by notified bodies.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Carry out tests pertaining to the conformity procedures for which they are designated.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: Applying REV ¶28 literally to Annex V point 6 (notified body must take out liability insurance); insurer not named and assigned no action.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Provide liability cover to notified bodies unless liability is assumed by the State.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A2(8), A7(2)-(3), A8(3): accredited/approved laboratories issue certificates of conformity with test data and give opinions when consulted by the Commission in disputes.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Carry out conformity tests and issue certificates with measurement data; when consulted under Article 8(3), give an opinion on a disputed suspension.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A37(1)-(5): independent organisations audit VLOP/VLOSE compliance and establish an audit report with an audit opinion and recommendations.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Audit VLOP/VLOSE compliance at least annually and issue an audit report with an opinion and, where not positive, operational recommendations.

QUALIFICATION_RATIONALE: A22: entities with recognised expertise in detecting, identifying and notifying illegal content, whose notices platforms must prioritise; status awarded and revocable by the DSC; reporting duties to the DSC.
FUNCTION_DESCRIPTION: Detect and notify illegal content to online platforms (priority notices) and report annually on notices to the awarding DSC and the public.
